summary: ARM_B (graph_proximity_weight=0.2) timeout rate = 96.0% at max_depth=5 on 74,778-edge corpus with hub nodes (temporal_out_degree 176-220). Graph walk unsafe to enable at delta=0.2. D3 repair (max_depth 5->2) required before quality ablation.

section_7_conditions.conclusion: Graph is unsafe to enable at delta=0.2 on a 74k-edge corpus regardless of quality result (§7 timeout null criterion)

additional_quality_finding.interpretation: Graph-sensitive probe construction (cosine<0.7 filter on causal+temporal edges) selects targets too semantically distant to appear in HNSW+BM25 candidate set. Graph boost as re-ranker (not expander) cannot promote targets not in initial candidate pool.

version_discrepancy.pgmnemo_0_18_0: GUC pgmnemo.graph_proximity_weight not registered -> current_setting() raised exception caught by EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS -> _graph_weight defaulted to 0.0 -> BFS never ran -> ARM_B equivalent to ARM_A (false pilot data)
version_discrepancy.pgmnemo_0_18_1: GUC properly registered -> BFS runs at max_depth=5 -> 96% timeout rate on hub nodes

required_before_quality_ablation: Apply D3: SET max_depth=2 in recall_hybrid graph_walk (pgmnemo--0.18.0--0.19.0.sql §3)
Verify ARM_B latency <200ms with no timeouts at n=10 warmup probes
Consider probe redesign: cosine<0.7 filter may be too strict for this corpus (targets unreachable even via graph boost); cosine<0.9 + rank>10 filter may produce better graph-sensitive probes
commit_note: PGMREL-0190-BENCH-GRAPH-ABLATION-RUN: latency-safety finding, publishable null result
